text:
Nina K: Quick sync for publisher "AuroraAI" marketplace onboarding. Need to reconcile cloud-specific packaging differences and finalize artifact bundle by EOD Thu. Who's picking up AMI/image mapping?
Tom B: I can map AMI/image families. Quick note: AWS wants HVM AMIs, GCP prefers a family name (we can use "aurora-llm-2026"), Azure needs a managed-image/vhd reference.
Eddie R: Also check kernel-driver compat for the GPU images on Azure. Last time we had a driver mismatch when the publisher used CUDA 12.1.
Priya S: I'll assemble the preview bundle: manifest + pricing metadata + deploy snippets for each cloud. Will include terraform example and a minimal helm chart for GKE.
Zara C: Legal/ops ask: confirm support contact and data handling for EU regions. Publisher said "no data persists outside customer VPC" but legal wants an explicit data flow blurb.
Tom B: AMI mapping plan: produce a csv with columns: cloud, region, image_id/family, note. I can start with us-east-1 and europe-west1.
Priya S: Packaging checklist I'm tracking: - buildpack tarball (sha256) - manifest.yaml - cloud-metadata.csv - trial-tier flags - sample billing.json - hero image + 1-line blurb
Nina K: For pricing metadata, include example cost-per-hour with/without autoscale and note reserved vs on-demand assumptions. Marketing will want the conservative number.
Eddie R: Runtime checklist: - cuda/cudnn versions - docker base image tag - kernel modules if required - supported instance types (g4dn, a2, etc)
Priya S: Sample manifest fragment (will include full JSON in portal):
```yaml
name: aurora-ai-buildpack
version: 0.9.1
artifacts:
  - buildpack-aurora-0.9.1.tar.gz
  - sha256: "REPLACE_WITH_SHA"
deploy:
  aws:
    ami_map:
      us-east-1: ami-0abcdef12345
  gcp:
    image_family: aurora-llm-2026
  azure:
    vhd: /subscriptions/xxx/resourceGroups/rg/providers/Microsoft.Compute/images/aurora-llm-2026
```
Zara C: Legal wants an explicit EEA data residency line and the publisher contact for DPA. Please upload DPA draft to /legal/inbound/aurora-ai.
Tom B: Heads-up: some regions have different image naming conventions; I'll flag region exceptions in the csv.
deploy-bot: Reminder: staging slot for aurora-ai expires at 1887654400 if artifacts aren't attached to the portal.
Nina K: OK owners: Packaging/Pricing=Priya, AMI/Image mapping=Tom, Runtime checks=Eddie, Legal/DPA=Zara. I'll coordinate handoff and book a 15-min demo with publisher tomorrow.
Priya S: ETA for manifest + bundle: Wed lunchtime. Will post a preview link to the portal and #partnerships.
Eddie R: I'll run a quick smoke on the pinned runtime images after Priya uploads. If kernel mismatch, fallback to pinned instance types and doc the caveat.
Zara C: I'll start the DPA draft today and ping publisher legal for signatures.
Tom B: CSV draft uploaded to Google Drive: https://drive.company/partnerships/aurora/ami-mapping.csv
Priya S: Uploaded preview bundle to portal (staging) and tagged @Nina K. Please review.
Nina K: Reviewed, small nit on pricing metadata. Priya, can you make the "max_instances" default 3? Keeps listing conservative.
Priya S: Done. Updated manifest and reuploaded.
deploy-bot: Notice: artifacts attached to portal. Staging slot retained until 1887654400.
Nina K: Thanks team — I'll update publisher and close this thread once signatures and final assets are in. :rocket:
